title: Fresh-clone regression baseline (no Postgres, no GitHub workflow files)
rule: The pre-push hook (ciDryRun → test:regression) must fail with exactly this set. A new failure, a missing name, or a listed test that starts passing is a refused push. Re-pin this file in its own reviewable commit when the set honestly changes.

failures.name: testEvidenceReading.mjs
failures.reason: Owner fixture pins an old scoring ruleset / evidence wording; left untouched until the owner re-pins.

failures.name: testLockedMinimumMargins.mjs
failures.reason: Owner fixture still expects Filter 2 'Below floor' hard-stop; live scoring marks it down instead.

failures.name: testPathToGo.mjs
failures.reason: Owner fixture pins 15 slots / old Path-to-GO totals; live is 18 slots (v5.7).

failures.name: testPathToGoActionCopy.mjs
failures.reason: Owner fixture pins pre-v5.7 Path-to-GO copy and a percent-only GO headline.

failures.name: testScoringRules.mjs
failures.reason: Owner fixture pins SCORING_RULESET_VERSION and shadow-mode / legacyPct behaviour; live is v5.7 with relevance on.

failures.name: owner-tests/testEvaluationStatus.mjs
failures.reason: Owner fixture treats a typed pure-commodity tick as an exemption; live requires a sourced finding.

failures.name: owner-tests/testFilter1Scoring.mjs
failures.reason: Owner fixture pins an old Filter 1 version and still credits junk text the invalid-input guard now zeros.

failures.name: owner-tests/testFilter2CogsGstPlan.mjs
failures.reason: Owner fixture sums Filter 2 credit as margin-only; live also scores pack size and person-entered GST.

failures.name: owner-tests/testFilter2Scoring.mjs
failures.reason: Owner fixture expects one Filter 2 scored item; live has three (margin, pack size, GST).

failures.name: owner-tests/testFilter3Scoring.mjs
failures.reason: Owner fixture asserts a fixed denominator of 15; live is 18 slots.

failures.name: owner-tests/testInputCoverage.mjs
failures.reason: Owner fixture expects stored answers to read 'assessed' without searchUsed; v5.6+ requires a web check.

failures.name: owner-tests/testPathCopy.mjs
failures.reason: Owner fixture pins screenshot-action worth and 15-slot Path-to-GO weights.

failures.name: owner-tests/testRelevanceScoring.mjs
failures.reason: Owner fixture asserts denominator 15 and shadow-mode / legacy verdict; live is 18 slots, relevance on.

failures.name: testPart70Health.mjs
failures.reason: Reads .github/workflows/keep-alive.yml, which is not in a fresh clone: the GitHub token has no workflow scope, so that file cannot be pushed.

postgresOnlyFailures.name: testTeamAndFieldAccess.mjs
postgresOnlyFailures.reason: Owner fixture expects firstForbiddenField('techShiftRisk') / a 403; Part 140 ignores server-owned keys. Skips on a fresh clone (no TEST_DATABASE_URL), so it is not in the clone-14. The hook's Postgres half still refuses any other extra name, and refuses a silent pass of this row.

postgresOnlyFailures.name: testLevelRescoring.mjs
postgresOnlyFailures.reason: Known gaps on combined-honest-detect: LV5 (per-idea level) and LV10 (Log Level column) live on other branches. Expected fail until those land.
